summary: Tribal Wars entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Tribal Wars

primary.why: Tribal Wars is a long-running browser strategy MMO, so the archive target is the current service plus world/account state. Mobile apps are companion access routes, not replacements for the browser account state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official browser version. Record world/server, tribe/account state, village count, premium use, browser, date/version, ruleset speed, and whether mobile-app access was used.

secondary.what_to_play: Compare only if documenting mobile access behavior.
secondary.why: The persistent world/account state is the core artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record world/server, ruleset, date, account state, tribe, premium use, and client route.
